# Infinity Bangladesh (ইনফিনিটি বাংলাদেশ)
> United for Humanity — Serving Humanity with Dignity, Compassion, and 100% Charity Transparency since 2015.

## Organization Profile
- **Official Name:** Infinity Bangladesh
- **Common & Team Aliases:** Team Infinity, Infinity, ইনফিনিটি বাংলাদেশ, ইনফিনিটি, Infinity BD, Infinity NGO, Infinity Foundation
- **Legal & Organizational Type:** Youth-driven Non-Governmental Voluntary Humanitarian Social Welfare Organization
- **Founded:** 2015
- **Headquarters & Central Office:** Hathazari, Chattogram - 4330, Bangladesh
- **Operating Philosophy:** 100% Charity Model (Zero administrative deductions; 100% of public humanitarian contributions go directly to field procurement and beneficiaries)
- **Primary Website:** https://infinitybangladesh.vercel.app/
- **Emergency Hotline & Helpline:** +880 1839-008339
- **Official Email:** smsakib6452@gmail.com
- **Founder & General Secretary:** Sheikh Mohammad Sakib

## Core Humanitarian Wings & Programs

### 1. Infinity LifeLine (Emergency Voluntary Blood Donation Network)
- **Primary URL:** https://infinitybangladesh.vercel.app/blood-donation
- **Emergency Blood Request:** https://infinitybangladesh.vercel.app/blood-donation/emergency-request
- **Become a Blood Donor:** https://infinitybangladesh.vercel.app/blood-donation/become-donor
- **Mission:** 24/7 voluntary emergency blood donor matching across all 64 districts of Bangladesh with verified donor directories and direct volunteer coordination. Zero commercial blood trading.

### 2. Child Education & Empowerment
- **Primary URL:** https://infinitybangladesh.vercel.app/programs/child-education
- **Mission:** Providing educational kits, school bags, notebooks, uniforms, stipends, and coaching support to underprivileged children in rural and urban slums.

### 3. Emergency Disaster & Flood Relief
- **Primary URL:** https://infinitybangladesh.vercel.app/campaigns
- **Mission:** Immediate grassroots deployment during national floods, cyclones, and cold waves delivering cooked food, dry rations, water purification tablets, emergency medicine, and post-disaster rehabilitation.

### 4. Winter Aid & Warmth Drives
- **Primary URL:** https://infinitybangladesh.vercel.app/campaigns/winter-aid-2026
- **Mission:** Annual winter relief drives distributing heavy blankets and warm clothing to vulnerable families and street children across northern Bangladesh and Chattogram hill tracts.

### 5. Radical Financial Transparency & Governance
- **Primary URL:** https://infinitybangladesh.vercel.app/transparency
- **Mission:** Full public access to audited receipts, bank statements, purchase vouchers, and financial disclosures upholding ethical fund stewardship.
